name: IT team · PM checkpoint — verify the three 12:00Z decisions were APPLIED to their dependent cards
description:
Context: on 20 Nov 12:00Z two decision cards run concurrently — `2506f948` (M1 demo slot + sign-off owner + QA-line deferral acceptance) and `e70e0272` (is the parent repo `codx-junior-platform` in scope, A/B/C). Both write their answers as comments on themselves. **Nothing on the board then checks that those answers were applied to the cards that depend on them**, which is the failure mode this shift found four times in different forms: a decision taken and never propagated.

Do (read-only unless a propagation is missing):
1. Read the last comment on `2506f948`. Verify: the slot is recorded as confirmed-for-21-Nov unless a human moved it; a sign-off owner is named OR the recording (`def4ce38` 11:00Z) is explicitly named as the demo artifact; the QA-line deferral is explicitly accepted or rejected. If any of the three is "TBC" or absent, write it now as the default (keep 21 Nov; recording is the demo) and say so.
2. Read the last comment on `e70e0272`. Apply the answer:
   - **A** (parent repo out of scope): close `25822947` as `done` with its own evidence table as closing evidence and a one-line note that the parent repo was never examined; comment on `d1ba037a` confirming it declares the **shell** gate and merges with `716c63f8`; confirm `248d0a54` closes as out of scope.
   - **B** (in scope): set `25822947` back to `todo` with a wake **after** `248d0a54` has landed, and confirm `d1ba037a` keeps its pytest acceptance with `248d0a54` as prerequisite.
   - **No answer:** apply A as default and write that an unanswered scope question is not an expansion of scope.
3. Verify the QA chain dates are **unchanged** at 24 Nov 10:00Z / 12:00Z / 14:00Z (`d1ba037a`, `5ee9dbfa`, `716c63f8`). If anyone moved them back onto 21 or 23 Nov, move them off — those are candidate demo days.
4. Verify no date moved on silence: `101588b6` 21 Nov 09:00Z, `4f055e99` 10:30Z, `def4ce38` 11:00Z, `6bceef9e` 12:15Z, `299d12ce` 23 Nov 09:00Z, `140668fe` 24 Nov 09:00Z must all be unchanged unless a named authorisation exists in a comment.

Acceptance: a comment on this card listing, per dependent card, either "applied" with the field/value, or "not applied — fixed now". Then close this card. Report M1 as on track / at risk / off track in the shift report with the evidence found in step 1.

Not in scope: re-litigating either decision, changing the demo date without a named authorisation, or touching `demo/` (frozen from 20 Nov 17:30Z).

## PM addendum (shift #7, turn 4) — one dependent was missing from your step list, and it is the one that makes the decision *take effect*

Your steps 1–4 cover the decision cards and the QA chain. They do **not** cover the two cards that carry the demo's consequence forward. Add these as **step 5**:

**5. Demo-consequence propagation (added this turn).** Read the recorded outcome on `2506f948` and check both branches:

- **Option A (default — demo stays Sat 21 Nov 13:00Z):**
  - `70832a68` (re-forecast) is at **Mon 23 Nov 08:00Z** — verify it has **not** been re-armed back onto Saturday 21 Nov. It is `ProjectManager`-owned and the PM seat is **mon–fri**, so a Saturday wake silently kills the only card that converts the demo into a re-plan.
  - `299d12ce` (M2) stays **23 Nov 09:00Z**, i.e. one hour *after* the re-forecast. Verify the order (**re-forecast 08:00Z → M2 09:00Z**) still holds; if M2 has been moved earlier, the re-forecast is worthless.
  - `140668fe` (M3) stays **24 Nov 09:00Z**.
- **Option B (demo moved to Mon 23 Nov 13:00Z):** the cascade I filed on `2506f948` must be **applied**, not merely noted: M2 `299d12ce` → **25 Nov**, M3 `140668fe` → **26 Nov**, `76b7c8e2` → **26 Nov**, `1ad984aa` → **27 Nov**, and `70832a68` re-armed **after** the demo (23 Nov 16:00Z) so it does not capture feedback that does not exist. Also verify `299d12ce`'s branch rule is respected: under B it does **read-only preparation until the demo outcome exists** — a route change before the demo would violate *demo before planning the next increment*.

**Why this matters more than it looks:** all four defects I fixed across this shift's four turns were the same shape — a decision taken, and nothing checking it landed on the card that depends on it. Your card is the only place that check exists. If step 5 finds a dependent that contradicts the decision, **fix the dependent and say so**; do not report it as an observation.

Still no scope change for you: read-only unless a propagation is missing.

## PM addendum 2 (shift #7, turn 4) — **step 6: you inherit an unfinished deliverable.** Do not close this card without it.

`fe9f284d` (write the M2/M3 demo scripts) wakes **Fri 20 Nov 10:00Z** — two hours **before** `e70e0272` answers whether `codx-junior-platform` is in scope. Since **M3 is application code in that repo**, I have ruled that at 10:00Z it writes:

- the **M2 script in full** (`299d12ce`) — decision-independent, needed by 23/25 Nov; and
- the **M3 script as a skeleton only**, with the demo steps left as a literal placeholder: `DEMO STEPS PENDING e70e0272 (20 Nov 12:00Z)`.

**You wake at 13:00Z, one hour after the answer lands. That placeholder is yours to finish.**

**Step 6 — finish the M3 demo script on `140668fe`:**
- If `e70e0272` = **A** (app repo out of scope): do **not** write an efforts walkthrough. Replace the placeholder with a one-line statement that M3 is re-sliced and the script is void, and note on `140668fe` that its 24 Nov session must open with the re-slice proposal. M3 does not get built as written.
- If **B** (in scope): fill the placeholder with the real walkthrough from `140668fe`'s own DEMO line — *open Settings → select an effort → the value persists and is applied to the model call* — in the M1 format (`b9aaf03c` is the template). Name the screenshot step as **`qa_explorer`**, which I added to that card this turn because `software_developer` and `qa_automation` have no browser and could never satisfy M3's own acceptance line.
- If **C** or no answer: the default is **A**. Apply it, and say so explicitly.

Then post on `fe9f284d` where the M3 script stands and close neither card on assumption.

**Why this is on your card and not a new one:** you already wake with both decisions in hand, and this shift's standing rule is that a follow-up without a `wake_at` is a lost follow-up. Adding a card at 12:00Z to do work a card at 13:00Z can do would just add an hour of latency and one more thing to keep in sync.

**Still binding:** read-only unless a propagation is missing — this is the one exception, and it is a *management artefact*, not build work.
